evidence.document: SCB Dokumentation av statistikens framtagning (UF0315, 2004–2006), embedded questionnaire question 13
evidence.question: VariabelReferenstid is “Enkäten Innovationsverksamhet 2004-2006” and the native edition is “2004 - 2006”. The answer meanings come from the wave's own questionnaire, question 13 (“Markera vilken typ av samarbetspartner ni hade samt dess lokalisering”), rows a–h by four locations. SWECOV's CIS2006 holdings name the answers co<row><location> by questionnaire position: the maintainer's aggregate MONA check (2026-10-14) found the 4-location waves (CIS2004, CIS2006) carry co11–co14 with no co15, so the location digit is the questionnaire column, and partner rows a–e have the same meaning under positional and later-wave readings. Rows co6x/co7x are declared from SCB's 7-category list (batch-e D4). This questionnaire has eight partner rows (e Konsulter, privata laboratorier; f Privata FoU-institut; g Universitet eller högskolor; h Offentliga forskningsinstitut) while SWECOV's CIS2006 holdings carry seven co row groups (co1x–co7x), so position cannot fix rows 6 and 7. The eighth row comes from splitting the 2002–2004 row e (consultants, private laboratories, private R&D institutes) into e and f, and no SCB document says how the delivery folds eight rows into seven (e.g. e+f merged with co6x = g and co7x = h as in 2002–2004, or one row dropped). The document's variable register names no value set for the matrix variable “Typ av samarbetspartner geografiskt fördelat”: its 8-alternative set belongs to “Mest värdefulla samarbetspartner”, and the 7-alternative “Typ av samarbetspartner” set (p. 66) is carried over verbatim from the 2002–2004 documentation. No other cell is asserted. SCB's quality declaration Appendix 2 (uf0315_kd_2018_ah_191113.pdf, pp. 23–27) lists this wave's questionnaire items on the same rows but names no co columns for it. Batch-e (maintainer decision 2026-10-16, #1603 batch-e D4): co5x/co6x/co7x are read on the 7-category list 'Typ av samarbetspartner' printed in this wave's documentation (PDF p. 66: e konsulter, privata laboratorier, privata FoU-institut; f universitet eller högskolor; g offentliga forskningsinstitut). That list is carried over word for word from 2002–2004, and nothing ties it to the delivered co columns; every answer's definition says so.
